description: This Java class defines a database change set that moves 'deleted' HL7 message records from the archive table to a queue table within the OpenMRS system, implementing the CustomTaskChange interface for Liquibase migrations.

classes.name: MoveDeletedHL7sChangeSet
classes.description: A class implementing a custom Liquibase change set for moving deleted HL7 records from the archive to the queue.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database operation to move deleted HL7 messages, inserting into the queue and deleting from archive.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation string after the operation completes.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the resource accessor; not utilized in this implementation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Performs setup actions before execution; no setup needed here.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the change set before execution; returns an empty ValidationErrors object.
